description: Inglés: japonés, escalada, cumpleaños; paráfrasis de Kiwi
turns: Hi! I've started learning Japanese, I practice every evening.
On weekends I go rock climbing with some friends.
My birthday is on March 12, so it's coming up soon.
Kiwi, my parrot, learned to whistle a new song.
Can you suggest a good app to practice Japanese?
